clips.title: The story
paras: At Sentinel Hill, Captain Danuvin helps hold Westfall's frontier together. He works with the People's Militia, directing volunteers and recruits to patrol roads and drive back Gnolls and outlaws. His orders protect the supply lines and farmlands from hostile hands.

Captain Danuvin coordinates patrols from Sentinel Hill's fortified tower. Stormwind's regular garrison has withdrawn, leaving Westfall's defenses badly weakened. He depends on travelers, farmhands, and volunteer fighters to keep some order across the plains.

Captain Danuvin focuses on the roads and open lands around Sentinel Hill. Riverpaw Gnolls raid near the central outposts, so he sends patrols to thin their packs and secure the perimeter. His orders help keep marauders and opportunists from surrounding the camp.
